name: The Last Barov
label: Quest
description: The Last Barov: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Naturally, with my brother still alive, there may be some contention as to the primary beneficiary of the family's fortune. This cannot be.
A low down guttersnipe like you isn't above a little cold-blooded murder, I hope.
It's a simple task and one that I expect you will complete; that is, if you wish to claim your reward.
Weldon sits under Alliance protection at Chillwind Camp, to the east. Slay him, return his head.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Secure my fortune and share in the spoils.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Wonderful! Now only I hold the power and fortune of house Barov!
And keep the change, you filthy animal.
